Name: (CP) Better Fish Ponds
Author: sharpskull2
Description:
[size=2]This mod edits the fishponddata.json file so that fish will produce more roe the higher the population, all fish start with 10 slots due to the removal of all population quests. Most fish have had the percent chance and drop rates for their secondary outputs increased so that you get more resources from fish ponds, and they have more worth in the mid to late game.[/size]

[size=4][b]Updated to 1.6
[/b][/size][size=2]Better Fish Ponds is now updated to the SDV version 1.6 and should hopefully work properly, don't hesitate to let me know if you encounter any bugs,
[/size]thank you

[size=4][b]COMPATIBILITY PATCH
[/b][/size]Version 1.4.0 of Better Fish Ponds is here, the compatibility patch, Better Fish Ponds should not work much better with other mods that affect the fish pond data, such as SVE which adds a lot of custom fish.

Compatibility still isn't perfect, so other mods that edit the vanilla fish pond values might not play well with this mod. However, it should work perfectly fine with mods that add in custom fish

[size=3][b]Patches
[/b][/size]There are currently two compat patches included within the mod that automatically activate when the other mods are installed
[size=3][b]SVE
Alchemistry 
[/b][/size]Feel free to request direct compat patches for other mods.

[size=4][b]TO-DO[/b][/size]

This would be more of a late game item to save space around the farm, and let you decorate to your heart's content without pesky fish ponds getting in the way :P[/size]


[size=4][b]Manual Install[/b][/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
﻿Mostly incompatible with other mods that affect the fishponddata.json file. By loading this mod before other mods that change the fishponddata.json file everything should work fine, but use together at your own risk
